title: olivia-hart-notes-to-self-2026-03-04
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick brain dump
2026-03-04 (wed)

Top of mind:
- Finish quick follow-up for canary rollout metrics (need 95th p50 broken down by model). Wait for SRE trace from @Riley.
- Chat with Product (Maya) at 1:30pm about UX for per-route cost breakdowns - jot down talking points.
- Sync with infra on Dedicated capacity forecast (Q2 commit) - update spreadsheet later.

TODO (short):
- [ ] Pull p50/p95 latency tables for last 24h for rtx-4x pool (INF-842)
- [ ] Add notes to PR 128 about fallback behavior when cache miss rate spikes
- [ ] Draft proposal for default batching policy for chat endpoints (aim for <=100ms median)
- [ ] Remind legal to sign updated DPA for enterprise PoC

Errands / personal reminders:
- buy gift for Samira (birthday Friday)
- groceries: milk, eggs, spinach (stop by market on way home)
- dentist appt Thu 9:30am (reschedule if clash)

Meeting notes / quick bullets:
- 10:00 - infra standup: mention autoscale flapping on staging; possible kernel selection bug when seq_len > 1024
- 11:15 - sync with Maya: propose showing token-level cost as percentage + absolute cost; ask about rollout cadence
- 15:00 - spike review: tests for continuous batching improvements (measure tail latency impact)

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Is there a rolling window we prefer for cache hit-rate alerts? (15m vs 1h) - ask SRE
- Should we expose quantization recommendation in console UI or keep in Optimize as a separate report? (Prod teams might prefer inline suggestions)

Quick links / refs:
- CONSOLE rollout confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CON/console-rollouts
- Jira: INF-842 (dedicated forecast), INF-799 (batching improvements)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/128 (WIP, awaiting review)

Notes to self (stream-of-consciousness):
- don't forget to capture an example prompt that triggers fallback to smaller model - need to reproduce locally
- when writing guidance for PMs, include explicit cost tradeoffs (tokens saved vs latency increase)
- draft email to enterprise POC about expanded observability trial (2-week extension?)

End of day checklist:
- [ ] Update spreadsheet for Dedicated commit estimates
- [ ] Post short summary in #eng-console about canary observations
- [ ] Upload example traces to the confluence page (link above)

Random quick idea: add "suggested actions" button in console next to anomaly alert -> create runbook + optional auto-rollback. Note this for design doc.
